generate_seed_corpus: generate seed corpus binary files for all fuzzers by combining CSV data and generated test samples
read_csv_samples: read a CSV file with fuzzer name and hex content columns and return a list of sample tuples
gen_utf8mb4_valid: generate valid UTF-8 multibyte string samples covering multiple languages like Greek, Japanese, and emoji
gen_utf8mb4_invalid: generate invalid UTF-8 byte sequence samples including overlong encodings and surrogate pairs for fuzzer testing
gen_escape_string: generate string escaping test samples with backslash escape options and single, double, and backtick quoting contexts
